verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a video-generation app, so an agent-drivable submit/watch/fetch/cost loop is a fair question for it. The evidence only describes a UI-driven flow: drop a reference on the home page, chat to approve, and watch agent logs and the Production line tab. The only CLI commands shown are `npm run doctor`, a setup check, and `post-video`, which publishes to social platforms. None of these is a documented programmatic way to submit a job, poll its status, download the asset, or report cost.
